top_failure_modes.hypothesis: Message doesn't cleanly match any of the 12 taxonomy intents (promotional content, meta-questions about the support account itself, vague venting). This is partly by design (general_other exists to catch these and route to escalation) but the classifier sometimes assigns high confidence to a specific wrong intent instead of recognizing OOD. Fix: dedicated OOD/novelty detection layer, not just relying on general_other cluster membership.
